draft.strengthQuote: Feisty play demeanor suits his love of contact.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.32, the 38th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 2nd of 11 at TE. He lasted until pick 83, well after his grade rank (38th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Drew Sample. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 218 receiving yards in 2020, 7th of 10 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 78 career games and 50 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2022. Versus the typical Year-5 tight end who played: 249 receiving yards against a median of 193, above the norm.
